Powering greater creators.

AI-powered tools and intelligent workflows for the future of media creation.
See the deals
Avid integrates AI-powered workflow orchestration and intelligent recommendations into the creative process to power iconic movies, binge-worthy TV, news, sports, music, and live performances.

TRUSTED BY

Innovation at Avid

Stem splitting, right in Pro Tools
The new 2026.11 release introduces Pro Tools Stem Separator—an Extension for fast, local AI-powered stem extraction.
Learn more
A technologist’s take on IBC2026
Avid’s Kenna Hilburn and Guillaume Aubuchon discuss IBC on the latest episode of Making the Media.
More mixing, less clicking. Now included.
SoundFlow Cloud Avid Edition—free with all Pro Tools Studio and Ultimate annual subs and Upgrade Plans. 
Learn more
Search with context, not file names
Most AI tools in media production only know metadata. Avid Assist knows the full context.
Skip setup. Start storytelling.
In the newest Media Composer update, explore faster multicam editing, collaboration updates, and more.
See the details
Agentic AI joins the editorial team
Ready to Edit syncs, transcribes, and organizes your project before you start cutting.
FilmLight finds a home in Media Composer
FilmLight brings native color tools to Media Composer, keeping color connected from dailies to delivery. 
See the details
Media Composer (feat. Google)
Google Gemini Enterprise and BigQuery enable remote collaboration and automate repetitive tasks in Media Composer. 
See the details
Introducing the New Avid Store
Start exploring deals on plugins and instruments you've always wanted and new releases from top plugin makers.
Shop now

BUILT FOR AGENTIC MEDIA PRODUCTION

Avid Content Core

Connect planning, production, and publishing across the systems you already use, gaining visibility into your content costs and performance. That connected context helps teams find what they need, utilizing AI agents to do real production work, within the permissions of the person who runs them.
See how Content Core connects production

AI-POWERED WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS

News Production

Turn stories into revenue-driving assets with Avid’s news solutions that integrate into your end-to-end workflow and orchestrate content with AI built in.
Transform your newsroom

Video Postproduction

Connect your entire stack from high-performance storage to AI-powered video editing software to elevate the craft of storytelling, now with Gemini Search.
Bring your story to life

Audio Post

Integrate Pro Tools with dedicated hardware to produce immersive audio at the highest quality available and translate perfectly to any system.
Design sound for stories

Live Sound

Scalable platforms for mixing today's biggest performances. From club tours to world stages, achieve flawless sound with industry-leading control and reliability.
Run the show

Music Creation

A world-class music production environment for composing and mixing, featuring AI assistance that keeps you in the flow.
Turn ideas into music

Education

Master the tools used by world-class pros. Access the industry-standard software and certification resources designed to launch and accelerate creative careers.
Start teaching and learning

DID YOU KNOW

20

Emmy Awards won by Avid for media innovation.

60+

Countries count on MediaCentral to break news.

3.5M+

Creators trust Avid audio solutions to create award-winning sound.

70K+

Journalists worldwide use Avid solutions daily.

OUR CUSTOMERS

Avid x Emmys®

Go behind the scenes with the 2026 Emmy®-nominated picture and sound teams to see how they brought some of this year’s most celebrated TV shows to life with Media Composer and Pro Tools.
See how they did it

Pete Koskimäki

SOUND DESIGNER & COMPOSER
“The idea was to build a custom frame where everything I need is within arm’s reach.”
Read about Soundsgood Audioworks

Michael P. Shawver, ACE

EDITOR
“Knowing that I’d worked on a few successful horror movies, I knew that I could bring a level of expertise that they could lean on me for.”
Hear about editing Sinners

Juan Peralta, ACE

RE-RECORDING MIXER
“You can feel the car with sound.”

Claudine Chedid

Senior Multimedia Journalist
“An integrated solution from Avid streamlines the time and steps required to switch between writing and editing.”
Read the story

WHAT'S NEW

Avid launches Ready to Play
Avid introduces a new AI-powered experience for Media Composer, helping editors create, understand, and transform media while keeping creative control firmly in their hands.
Learn more
Pro Tools 2026.11 is available now
Discover new features and enhancements that expand creative possibilities and elevate music creation and audio post-production.
Learn more
Everything but the Cut
120 members of the prestigious American Cinema Editors (ACE) told us where they plan to utilize AI in post production, and where they’ll never let AI step in.
Learn more
What to expect in Media Composer 2026.8
Get the latest info about how Media Composer 2026.8 impacts Shared Projects on storage outside Avid NEXIS.
Learn more
Making the Media S6E07: Suite Streams
The founder of Streamwell, Brian Chahley, explains remote collaboration and review and approval in Media Composer.
Making the Media S6E08: The DNx Factor
Intel’s Brijender Bharti breaks down how Avid and Intel are working together to power modern media workflows.
Composing Avatar: Fire and Ash
Simon Franglen takes you inside his creative process that connects Sibelius and Pro Tools.
Mixing & Editing F1: The Movie®
How do you make audiences feel the speed, danger, and precision of Formula One racing? We got the answers.
Learn more
